fixes.en: To prepare for emergencies like a Zentradi remnant revolt or unseen threats,\nregular U.N. Forces training begins. Beat each Destroid squad in mock battle.
fixes.why: refit: 'as yet unseen' -> 'unseen'; 'we will now conduct' -> 'begins'; 'fight mock battles... and win' -> 'beat... in mock battle'

fixes.en: Rioting Zentradi remnants have ignored a call to surrender and still run wild.\nTo put down the riot at once, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.
fixes.why: refit: 'are still on the rampage' -> 'still run wild'

fixes.en: This test assesses your aptitude as a test pilot for Project Super Nova,\nthe next main VF contest. Win the mock battle against the Valkyrie squad.
fixes.why: refit: 'competition for the next main variable fighter' -> 'next main VF contest'

fixes.en: A flight test now begins to measure the prototype's thrust, agility and more.\nRun a time trial to measure how long you take to clear all the waypoints.
fixes.why: refit: 'flight performance, including thrust and maneuverability' -> 'thrust, agility and more'

fixes.en: To test the prototype's agility, we'll fly it in a confined space like a base.\nRun a time trial: destroy all targets and reach the target area.
fixes.why: refit: 'like the inside of a base' -> 'like a base'; dropped 'as fast as you can' (implied by time trial)

fixes.en: To gauge the prototype's combat ability, we'll now stage an arena mock battle.\nBattle a large number of targets, simulating combat against multiple enemies.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: We've had reports of Zentradi remnants appearing from a planet near Eden.\nWe'll now annihilate them, also as a live combat test of the prototype.
fixes.why: refit: 'planet Eden' -> 'Eden'; second mention of Zentradi remnants -> 'them'

fixes.en: For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock air battle now begins.\nDestroy the VF-11 and drone-escorted bombers short of the target area.
fixes.why: refit: 'in a range of environments' -> 'in varied settings'; 'before they reach' -> 'short of'

fixes.en: For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock sea battle now begins.\nSink the multipurpose carrier escorted by VF-11s, Destroids and an Aegis ship.
fixes.why: refit: 'Destroid squads' -> 'Destroids'; 'Destroy' -> 'Sink' (carrier)

fixes.en: For prototype combat data in varied settings, a mock ground battle now begins.\nDestroy the base defended by VF-11s and Destroid squads.
fixes.why: refit: 'in a range of environments' -> 'in varied settings'

fixes.en: For head-to-head prototype data, we now hold a mock battle against the rival.\nNeedless to say, it's the most crucial test for selection. Win at any cost.
fixes.why: refit: 'prototype against prototype' -> 'head-to-head'; 'rival model' -> 'rival'

fixes.en: U.N. troops have run amok at the anniversary ceremony in Macross City, Earth.\nTo end this crisis of unknown cause, subdue the rampaging soldiers at once.
fixes.why: refit: 'U.N. Forces soldiers' -> 'U.N. troops'; 'bring this emergency under control' -> 'end this crisis'

fixes.en: U.N. troops have run amok at the anniversary ceremony in Macross City, Earth.\nTo end this crisis of unknown cause, subdue the rampaging soldiers at once.
fixes.why: refit: 'U.N. Forces soldiers' -> 'U.N. troops'; 'bring this emergency under control' -> 'end this crisis'

fixes.en: U.N. troops have run amok at the anniversary ceremony in Macross City, Earth.\nTo end this crisis of unknown cause, subdue the rampaging soldiers at once.
fixes.why: refit: 'U.N. Forces soldiers' -> 'U.N. troops'; 'bring this emergency under control' -> 'end this crisis'

fixes.en: Sharon Apple has run out of control and seized U.N. Forces central command.\nTo free the people her song is manipulating, destroy Sharon immediately.
fixes.why: refit: passive -> active; tighter wording

fixes.en: Sharon Apple has run out of control and seized U.N. Forces central command.\nTo free the people her song is manipulating, destroy Sharon immediately.
fixes.why: refit: passive -> active; tighter wording

fixes.en: I want to see him. I want to see him smile. He... Isamu will be here soon.\nI've waited for you, Isamu. Only you. Nothing stands between us anymore...
fixes.why: refit: 'the joy on his face' -> 'him smile'; 'I've been waiting' -> 'I've waited'

fixes.en: I want to see him. I want to see him smile. He... Isamu will be here soon.\nI've waited for you, Isamu. Only you. Nothing stands between us anymore...
fixes.why: refit: 'the joy on his face' -> 'him smile'; 'I've been waiting' -> 'I've waited'

fixes.en: A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 that an unknown force has ambushed it.\nAnnihilate the unknown craft to keep them away from the Macross 7 fleet.
fixes.why: refit: 'unidentified' -> 'unknown'; 'any closer to' -> 'away from'

fixes.en: A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 that an unknown force has ambushed it.\nAnnihilate the unknown craft to keep them away from the Macross 7 fleet.
fixes.why: refit: 'unidentified' -> 'unknown'; 'any closer to' -> 'away from'

fixes.en: Danger always lurks on a journey through vast space. To prepare for the worst,\nbeat Diamond Force member Lt. Gamlin Kizaki in a training mock battle.
fixes.why: refit: 'the vastness of space' -> 'vast space'; 'emergencies' -> 'the worst'

fixes.en: Citizens kidnapped by the Varauta Army are being carried off in containers.\nAnnihilate the Varauta escort and bring the containers to the designated area.
fixes.why: refit: 'Varauta forces transporting the containers' -> 'Varauta escort'

fixes.en: The Varauta Army is trying to re-fold City 7, now cut off from Battle 7.\nRetake the generator, annihilate the Varauta Army and stop the re-fold.
fixes.why: refit: 'which has been cut off' -> 'now cut off'

fixes.en: The Varauta Army suddenly appeared during the crowded Battroid Carnival.\nKeep citizens safe: guard the Monsters while annihilating the Varauta Army.
fixes.why: refit: 'where crowds of citizens had gathered' -> 'crowded'; restructured purpose clause

fixes.en: Battle 7's relief escorts were wiped out instantly by a mysterious Varauta foe.\nAnnihilate the Varauta Army to protect the citizens of City 7.
fixes.why: refit: 'escort ships sent from Battle 7 to help' -> 'Battle 7's relief escorts'

fixes.en: Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks.\nAnnihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.
fixes.why: refit: 'has chosen this crisis to attack' folded into 'Just as... attacks'

fixes.en: Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks.\nAnnihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.
fixes.why: refit: 'has chosen this crisis to attack' folded into 'Just as... attacks'

fixes.en: Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet.\nSink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.
fixes.why: refit: 'unprecedented crisis' -> 'worst crisis yet'; 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

fixes.en: Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet.\nSink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.
fixes.why: refit: 'unprecedented crisis' -> 'worst crisis yet'; 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

fixes.en: We've spotted a likely Protodeviln, approx. 300 m long, unlike any foe so far.\nMake survival your top priority, and destroy the Protodeviln if possible.
fixes.why: refit: 'enemy contact believed to be' -> 'likely'; 'clearly unlike' -> 'unlike'

fixes.en: We captured a Protodeviln, but let its would-be rescuers break into Battle 7.\nAnnihilate the intruders and stop them from seizing the Protodeviln.
fixes.why: refit: 'the enemy coming to rescue it' -> 'its would-be rescuers'; 'the enemy inside Battle 7' -> 'the intruders'

fixes.en: The Protodeviln have gotten serious and are attacking the Macross 7 fleet.\nWe can't let the Protodeviln beat us here. Annihilate the Varauta Army.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: Ahead of the escalating Protodeviln war, a mock battle will now be held.\nBeat the married duo: a genius pilot of old in the latest model, and an ex-ace.
fixes.why: refit: 'husband-and-wife' -> 'married'; 'of years past' -> 'of old'; 'machine' -> 'model'; 'former ace' -> 'ex-ace'

fixes.en: We now launch Operation Stargazer, a surprise assault by a small elite force.\nWipe out the Varauta Army at all costs to fire reaction weapons into the cave.
fixes.why: refit: dropped quote marks; 'target cave' -> 'the cave'; 'Annihilate' -> 'Wipe out'

fixes.en: Capt. Gamlin, possessed by the Protodeviln, is on a rampage, wrecking bases.\nWe can't allow more damage. You're authorized to shoot down Capt. Gamlin.
fixes.why: refit: 'military facilities' -> 'bases'; Captain -> Capt.

fixes.en: To thwart Gepelnitchi's ambition, the "Spiritia Farm Project,"\nand to protect galactic peace, destroy Varauta Army commander Gepelnitchi.
fixes.why: refit: 'the peace of the galaxy' -> 'galactic peace'

fixes.en: To thwart Gepelnitchi's ambition, the "Spiritia Farm Project,"\nand to protect galactic peace, destroy Varauta Army commander Gepelnitchi.
fixes.why: refit: 'the peace of the galaxy' -> 'galactic peace'

fixes.why: refit: 'the peace of the galaxy' -> 'galactic peace'

fixes.en: A vanguard ship has been wiped out by a large rogue Meltrandi fleet.\nThey mustn't get any closer to the Macross 7 fleet. Annihilate the rogue fleet.
fixes.why: refit: 'We can't let them' -> 'They mustn't'

fixes.en: Reviving our master, Lord Gepelnitchi, requires a vast amount of Spiritia.\nAttack the fleet showing a massive Spiritia reaction and harvest its Spiritia.
fixes.why: refit: restructured; 'where... was detected' -> 'showing'

fixes.en: The Anima Spiritia's power has at last revived Lord Gepelnitchi's true body.\nFight beside the mighty Lord Gepelnitchi and annihilate those Anima Spiritia.
fixes.why: refit: active voice; 'fearsomely powerful' -> 'mighty'

fixes.en: Galaxy Whales are nearing orbit; we've detected likely poachers hunting them.\nArrest them once confirmed. You may ignore the civilian craft also spotted.
fixes.why: refit: 'confirmed as poachers' -> 'confirmed'; merged civilian-craft clause

fixes.en: When the Galaxy Whales near Zola, poachers flock to the planet in droves.\nTo prepare, the Zolan Star Patrol holds its regular training: a mock battle.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording

fixes.en: The Galaxy Whales are nearing Zola again: prime hunting season for poachers.\nWe can't ignore their poaching any longer. Take the poachers into custody.
fixes.why: refit: 'turn a blind eye to' -> 'ignore'

fixes.en: Undercover with the poachers, Officer Liza is trying to flee in a stolen VF-17.\nEscort her to the target area, then arrest the poachers and black marketeers.
fixes.why: refit: 'Once she is safe, move on to' -> 'then'

fixes.en: Poachers aim a reaction weapon at the white Galaxy Whale hampering their hunt.\nProtect the whale from the weapon at all costs and arrest the poachers.
fixes.why: refit: 'plan to use... to get rid of' -> 'aim... at'; second mentions shortened

fixes.en: Basara: "Sing to the whales? Heh, not just the whales! I'll make all of you\n         out here listen to my song! Here we go! Listen to my song!!"
fixes.why: refit: 'You want me to sing to the whales?' -> 'Sing to the whales?'; 'every last one of you out here' -> 'all of you out here'

fixes.en: An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to\nhide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.
fixes.why: refit: 'New U.N. Forces' -> 'New U.N.'; restructured; break moved mid-sentence (as JP)

fixes.en: A mock battle now begins as our regular joint drill with the New U.N. Forces.\nShow them what S.M.S. can really do, and win the mock battle.
fixes.why: refit: dropped repeat of 'against the New U.N. Forces'

fixes.en: The Victors that struck Macross Frontier never left; they seem to be hiding\nin Island 3's foundation block. Annihilate them before they near Island 1.
fixes.why: refit: 'did not retreat' -> 'never left'; break moved mid-sentence (as JP)

fixes.en: The final test for S.M.S. applicants begins now. To help out, join the\napplicants in a mock battle against Pixie Team, led by Capt. Klan Klang.
fixes.why: refit: 'To help with the test' -> 'To help out'; Captain -> Capt.

fixes.en: To prepare for Vajra attacks, a mock battle begins now. Beat Maj. Ozma Lee's\nSkull Squadron, one of the finest elite units in all of S.M.S.
fixes.why: refit: 'Win against Major' -> 'Beat Maj.'

fixes.en: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack.\nWipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.
fixes.why: refit: 'Galaxy survivors' -> 'survivors'

fixes.en: We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible,\nbut the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording; 'Switch to wiping out the Vajra' -> 'Move swiftly to wipe them out'
